executive_summary: The automated test report for the web app at https://claude.ai reveals significant issues, particularly with security and smoke tests. Critical security vulnerabilities related to missing HSTS headers and multiple HTTP 403 errors in smoke and functional tests indicate potential access control issues.

ai_issues.title: HTTP 403 Error on API Redirect
ai_issues.root_cause: Access control misconfiguration or incorrect permissions.
ai_issues.business_impact: Users unable to download necessary setup files, leading to potential loss of user trust and revenue.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Review and correct access control settings for the API endpoint.

ai_issues.title: HTTP 403 Error on Main Page
ai_issues.root_cause: Access control misconfiguration or incorrect permissions.
ai_issues.business_impact: Users unable to access the main page, severely impacting user experience and engagement.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Ensure proper access permissions are set for the main page.

ai_issues.title: Missing HSTS Header
ai_issues.business_impact: Increased risk of man-in-the-middle attacks, compromising user data security.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Implement HSTS headers to enforce secure connections.

ai_issues.title: Missing HSTS Header
ai_issues.business_impact: Increased risk of man-in-the-middle attacks, compromising user data security.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Implement HSTS headers to enforce secure connections.

ai_issues.title: HTTP 403 Error on Login Page
ai_issues.root_cause: Access control misconfiguration or incorrect permissions.
ai_issues.business_impact: Users unable to log in, affecting user retention and satisfaction.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Review and correct access control settings for the login page.

ai_issues.title: Missing Referrer-Policy Header
ai_issues.business_impact: Potential leakage of referrer information, affecting user privacy.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Add a Referrer-Policy header to control referrer information.

ai_issues.title: Missing Permissions-Policy Header
ai_issues.business_impact: Potential misuse of browser features, affecting security and privacy.
ai_issues.fix_recommendation: Add a Permissions-Policy header to restrict browser features.
